# ARC-0005 · Toolkit crashes on the first launch, works on the second

**Goal:** the Toolkit opens the Arcana project on the first try.
**Intent:** the Owner stops paying a crash per launch after every update.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] The one data error the engine reports for the mod is fixed: `COMPREHEND_SUPERNATURAL` `AuraStatuses` has
      `ApplyStatus(DETECT_SUPERNATURAL_ABERRATION,100,_1)` — `_1` must be `-1` (log: `failed to parse stats expression
      string "_1"`), in the game `.txt` and the Toolkit `.stats`.
- [x] Owner test: open the Toolkit, close it normally, open it again — 4 launches, no crash (2026-10-12).

## Findings (2026-10-12)

- Every crash today (12:26, 12:54, 13:15, 14:51, 15:30, 15:48 local) has the same stack: `ls::anubis::System::LoadFramework`
  → `TreeRef::UpdateExpressions` → `ls::khonsu::Machine::FindScript` → read access violation. It is preceded in
  `log.*.txt` by four `!CRITICAL! Double delete detected` (`BlocksAllocator<64>::Free`, Noesis UI teardown) at the
  client state swap to `LoadSession`: memory is freed twice, then the AI framework load reads it.
- The crashing and the working session load exactly the same data up to that point (normalised logs identical,
  same 22 design asserts). So the data is not what differs between them.
- Not every update is followed by a crash (14:02, the first launch after stage 3, opened fine), and 15:48 crashed
  with no change to the mod since the last good session. Every crash was followed by a working launch within a
  minute; launches after a normal close usually crashed.
- Toolkit binaries unchanged since 2026-07-31; the mod's Khonsu helpers unchanged since 2026-10-07.
- The `_1` typo predates the project migration (2026-10-11), so it cannot be what made the crash frequent; it is
  fixed because it is the only data error the engine reports for the mod, and a failed parse is a plausible source
  of a bad pointer.

## Log

- 2026-10-12 — investigated (read only): crash dumps, `errors.*`, `log.*`, Story, editor settings. Ticket created.
- 2026-10-12 — `[fechado]`: `_1` → `-1` in `COMPREHEND_SUPERNATURAL` (game .txt and Toolkit .stats, one occurrence each; entry counts unchanged); selftest 992/0, check_cards OK. Waiting for the Owner's open/close/open test.
- 2026-10-12 — three more crashes (launch, Reload Story after a clean compile — 0 errors —, launch). Full stack from `log.*`: the double delete happens inside `ls::FileManager::OpenFile` called by `ls::khonsu::Machine::FindScript` during the Anubis load — Khonsu opening a script file from disk. `[fechado]`: the nine one-function helpers merged into `Scripts/thoth/helpers/ArcanaHelpers.khn` (9 of 9 bodies identical; originals in `90_ARCHIVE/93_Old_Versions/2026-10-12_ARC-0005_khn_merged`). Waiting for the Owner's open/close test.
- 2026-10-12 — **fixed.** After the nine Khonsu helpers were merged into `ArcanaHelpers.khn`, the Owner opened the Toolkit 4 times without a crash (it crashed on most launches before). So the trigger was the mod's loose one-function `.khn` files being opened during the AI load (the Toolkit's file cache double-freed under that load) — not the data in them, and not unrelated to the mod as first thought. Rule kept: helpers live in ONE file. Done.
tickets.title: Toolkit crashes on the first launch, works on the second

The Kingmaker audit goes with its 05 handoff. - [x] Handoffs for the Kingmaker: Context Keeper (`05.02` + Depth audit, `05.00`, `05.06`), Lore Writer (`31.01`), Localization (`33.03`); `21.08` Kingmaker column with Axis = Balance; `10.06` updated. - [x] Every gap resolved by a decision in `21.04/Kingmaker/DECISIONS.md` (SP47–SP103) or listed as open (spec §14). - [x] Raising spec written: `21.04/Kingmaker/DESIGN.md` (§1.5 sections, Identity Sheet complete, no audit inside). - [x] Balance pass: numbers in `25.01`–`25.02` (11 SPL, 6 FEAT), arithmetic in `22.05/2026-10-13_ARC-0008_Kingmaker_Balance.md` (approved). ## Gates - [x] Design gate (`21.04/_SUBCLASS_STANDARD.md` §15) — answered 2026-10-13, passes with three notes (below) - [x] Narrative gate (`32.04`) — passed 2026-10-15, recorded in `32.04/ARC-0008_Kingmaker.md` (second sentence, panel line, tag line, *Fortune's Reach*, 52 tooltips) - [ ] DoD (`00.03`) ### Design gate (2026-10-13) Answered by the main session in the roles the standard names. | # | Question | Answer | |---|---|---| | 1 | Pillar and fantasy (Lead Class Designer) | `21.01` (Vision and Pillars) **does not exist yet**; checked against the class pillars in `31.01` §1 — **Tarot**: the Rota Fortunae read literally; **Mystra and the Weave**: SP95's sentence, Atropos cuts the thread; **Destiny at level 1**: own chassis (CHA, Courtier, Sorcerer voice). Fantasy *"I don't win fights. I decide who does."* is what the kit does (SP97) | | 2 | Role without duplication, `21.08` (Lead Class Designer) | Force multiplier, axis **Balance** (free). Note: the role sits close to the Resonant's (support through states); different axis (Balance vs Combination); the class's magical-DPR gap is a future ticket (`10.06`) | | 3 | Resource and recharge, `26` (Spell Designer) | Woven Spell Slots / Threads for the cards (Long Rest / per turn); Turn the Spoke no slot (Bonus Action); Peripeteia, Usurp, Rota Fortunae once per combat; The Wheel Stops and the Master of Coin once per Long Rest; the Court is named once per Long Rest. The Wheel itself costs nothing | | 4 | Power on the curve, `22` (Balance Designer) | ≈ 88 % of the budget per turn at T1 (no Court yet), ≈ 92 % at T2, ≈ 95–100 % at T3 counting the tiers and the capstone (`22.05` §6); leans weak early, on purpose | | 5 | One tooltip read; complexity budget (Lead Class Designer) | The core rule fits one passive (The Rota); a new player can name the signature (the Wheel, the Crossing) after one fight. **11 combat actions** against the standard's suggested 3 (suggestion until an ADR); one main resource (positions) and one secondary (the Court, set before battle) | | 6 | Interactions (Balance Designer) | No Concentration in the kit; Coronation and Turn the Spoke share the Bonus Action (a choice); one position per creature, Advantage sources don't stack (SP52); Crossing once per enemy per round; Hubris consumed; Nemesis moves only Falling enemies; Master of Coin once per Long Rest — no open loop | | 7 | Core 1–12 without 13–20 (Validator) | Complete at 12 (capstone 11, Tier III 12); nothing depends on 13–20 | | 8 | Intent in one sentence (Spell Designer) | *The Kingmaker makes the party stronger by keeping allies at the top of Fortune's Wheel while enemies hit the bottom — and every fall beside a reign hurts.* | **Notes:** (1) `21.01` has to be written (pillars for the whole class) — proposal for the Owners; (2) the complexity budget is above the suggestion until an ADR fixes it; (3) the T1/T3 percentages are rough and go to the playtest. ## Log - 2026-10-08 — design conversation (before the project migration): `21.04/Spinner/2026-10-08-spinner-design.md`. - 2026-10-13 — created; decisions SP1–SP43 recorded from that conversation; audit against the current §3 done and handed to the Context Keeper. Gaps to brainstorm, in order: **K3 ultimate** (and A3), the **complexity budget** (§15: ~25 combat actions), then I6 names, W1, D1/D2; balance pass after. - 2026-10-13 — three alternative proposals for the raise (A Measured Thread · B Rise and Fall · C Fortuna's Wager) in `93/2026-10-15_Kingmaker_raise_proposals/2026-10-13-spinner-three-proposals.md`; awaiting the Owner's choice (SP47). - 2026-10-13 — brainstorm with the Owner: direction B *Rise and Fall* chosen, subclass renamed **The Kingmaker**; decisions SP47–SP71 (Wheel positions, King/Regent, the Court/Small Council, verbs, Crossing, Cut, Peripeteia, The Wheel Stops, chassis, progression). Next: Hubris fix, Awakening, card details, edge cases, raising spec. - 2026-10-13 — SP72 (Hubris: who reigned falls harder). The old Spinner audit handoff, never applied, archived in `90/93/2026-10-13_ARC-0008_spinner_audit` (design replaced by the Kingmaker); the Kingmaker gets its own audit with the raising spec. Owner's note: the Kingmaker's role sits close to the Resonant's (support through states) and the mod still lacks a magical burst/DPR subclass — a future tarot card will fill that gap (not this ticket). - 2026-10-13 — brainstorm closed: SP72–SP103 (Hubris, Succession, Awakening Tyche/Nemesis/Aspect of Anticipation, Usurp, Foreseen, card details, edge cases, Identity Sheet, names, Osiris drives the Wheel). # ARC-0009 · Create the Lionheart (was the Titan) to the subclass standard (design)

**Goal:** design the Lionheart — tarot **VIII · Strength**, the slot the game still calls *Titan* — from the
evaluation questions of `_SUBCLASS_STANDARD.md` to a raising spec, the same path the Resonant (ARC-0002) and
the Kingmaker (ARC-0008) took.
**Intent:** the Lionheart replaces the placeholder copy of the Resonant level-1 kit with a kit of its own, so
the subclass plays its own fantasy from level 1.

## Where the work goes

The design runs in a separate cloud session (Owner, 2026-10-14). When it is finished, that session commits and
pushes with this ticket's id first in every commit message, and updates:

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Brainstorm decisions (one id per answer, `LH1`…) | `50_ENGINEERING/55_Implementation_Specs/_wip/Lionheart/decisions.md` |
| Raising spec (§1–15 of the standard) | `20_GAME_DESIGN/21_GDD_Arcana_Class/21.04_Subclasses/Lionheart/` (folder exists, empty) |
| Player-facing texts (draft until the Narrative gate) | `50_ENGINEERING/55_Implementation_Specs/_wip/Lionheart/texts.md` |
| Numbers (ADR-0005: only here) | `20_GAME_DESIGN/25_Master_Data/25.01…` (`SPL_Lionheart_*`), `25.02…` (`FEAT_Lionheart_*`) |
| Balance pass | `20_GAME_DESIGN/22_Balance_DnD5e/22.05_Balance_Reports/` |
| Role and axis column | `20_GAME_DESIGN/21_GDD_Arcana_Class/21.08_Subclass_Matrix.md` |
| Handoffs (Context Keeper, Lore Writer, Localization) | the receiving department's folder, `HANDOFF_LeadClassDesigner_to_<Role>_ARC-0009.md` |
| Implementation spec and Toolkit entry guide | `55/SPEC_ARC-0009.md`, `55/TOOLKIT_ARC-0009.md` (from `_TEMPLATE_TOOLKIT_GUIDE.md`) |
| Ticket progress | this file (criteria, gates, log); then `perl 80_TOOLS_AND_PIPELINE/82_Automation/update_board.pl` |

**Already in the game, not committed yet (Owner, Toolkit, 2026-10-14):** tag `2a90eb1d…` renamed THETITAN →
THELIONHEART, `EQP_CC_Lionheart` in `Equipment.stats`, the class name handle `ha017a8f9…` = "The Lionheart". The
ProgressionDescription still reads *Titan*. They are synced to `51` and wait for this ticket's first commit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every evaluative question of §3 answered for the Lionheart.
- [ ] Every Owner decision recorded in `55/_wip/Lionheart/decisions.md`; open points listed in the spec.
- [ ] Raising spec written in `21.04/Lionheart/` (§1.5 sections, Identity Sheet complete).
- [ ] Role and axis in `21.08` without duplicating another subclass (note: the class lacks a magical burst/DPR subclass — `10.06`, ARC-0008).
- [ ] Balance pass: numbers in `25.01`–`25.02`, arithmetic in `22.05`.
- [ ] Handoffs sent (Context Keeper `05.02/Lionheart.md`, Lore Writer, Localization).
- [ ] `SPEC_ARC-0009` and `TOOLKIT_ARC-0009` written for the Owner's Toolkit entry.

## Gates

- [ ] Design gate (`21.04/_SUBCLASS_STANDARD.md` §15)
- [ ] Narrative gate (`32.04`)
- [ ] DoD (`00.03`)

## Log

- 2026-10-14 — created (Owner request during ARC-0008). Design in a separate cloud session; the Toolkit changes
  above stay out of the ARC-0008 commit.
- 2026-10-14 — brainstorm (cloud session): direction **D · Two Hands, One Foe** chosen over A–C and E–F;
  decisions LH1–LH19 in `55/_wip/Lionheart/decisions.md` (Aspect of Courage, the Villain by highest maximum HP,
  One Labour at a Time, Stand Before the Beast, cards as Lion / Maiden containers, Finisher, Fang and Shield,
  Strength secondary). Next: chassis (saves, armour, weapons, skills), progression, Awakening, pool.
- 2026-10-15 — brainstorm continued in the cloud session up to LH61 (chassis, Awakening, ultimate, capstone
  *Lion's Judgement*, full 1–12 progression, form dice and defences). Hand-off to the Claude Desktop session:
  open questions, T2 checks and next topics at the end of `55/_wip/Lionheart/decisions.md`.

# ARC-0024 · Playtest tickets (QA-####) and a Playtests tab on the Arcana Board

**Goal:** every pending in-game test lives on the board as a QA-#### ticket per subclass, loose feature or bug retest.
**Intent:** the Owner opens the Toolkit, picks one card and tests everything it lists; nothing to test is lost.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Playtest tickets `QA-####` (own sequence) in `10.01_Product_Backlog/playtests/`, `type: playtest`,
      `kind: subclass | feature | bug-retest`, with `subclass:`, `build: ARC-####` and `guide:` (the guide JSON).
- [ ] A script generates a QA ticket from a guide JSON: one section per session, one checkbox per test (id, title, rule).
- [ ] Kanban sync also reads the Arcana Test Guides results (`results/<ARC>_<test>`) and writes pass / fail / skipped
      on each test line of the QA tickets.
- [ ] Arcana Board has a Playtests tab (Backlog · Ready · In QA · Done) with search and filters; the Board tab keeps
      the other tickets. Cards show progress (✓ / ✗ / left).
- [ ] Done refuses a playtest while any test is left or failed (skipped counts as resolved).
- [ ] A failed test opens an ARC bug ticket and a QA bug-retest ticket blocked by it (rule written in `00.03`).
- [ ] Company rule in `00.03`: every build (subclass or feature) closes only with its test guide and its QA ticket.
- [ ] First tickets: QA-0001 Resonant (GUIDE_ARC-0017, 33 tests) and QA-0002 Kingmaker (GUIDE_ARC-0008, 49 tests),
